name: visualize
description: Create publication-quality figures that meet journal submission standards. APA 7th defaults with journal-specific overrides. Supports interaction plots, mediation path diagrams, forest plots, marginal effects, Johnson-Neyman plots, correlation heatmaps, and coefficient plots. All figures are colorblind-safe, high DPI, and exported in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, SVG, TIFF). Use when the user says "publication figures," "journal figures," "APA figures," "visualize results," "make plots," "interaction plot," "path diagram," "forest plot," or when /analyze or /process-model or /robustness completes. Triggers on "visualize," "figure," "plot," "diagram."
